_comment: Credits shown in About > Bibles and commentaries (assets/legal/bible_modules_<ui>.md). One entry per module that is mentioned: the English pack and the lite Spanish pack (first run), then every new language. NEVER the full Spanish pack. status: ok = shown; hidden = never shown (an editorial copyright or a permission is needed: user's decision 2026-10-21); review = facts missing, ask the user before showing it. Copied to <app>/cdn/bible/module-credits.json on the first run; after that the app repo copy is the source. Text fields (language, year, by, licence, notes) are a plain string, the same in every document, or {"en": ..., "es": ...}: the documents are only in English and Spanish (user's decision 2026-10-21).
